title: Correct string tension
description: Essential: Student must provide the final expression for tension T = ½ mω²L or equivalent simplified form.

title: Correct planet density
description: Essential: Student must provide the final expression for density ρ = 9Lω²/(8μπGR) or equivalent simplified form.

title: Correct cosmic velocity
description: Essential: Student must provide the final expression for first cosmic velocity v = ω√(3RL/(2μ)) or equivalent simplified form.

title: Force balance reasoning
description: Important: Student must apply Newton's second law to each mass, considering centripetal force, friction, and tension.

title: Gravitational acceleration derivation
description: Important: Student must relate surface gravity g to planetary mass M using Newton's law of gravitation.

title: Friction at limiting condition
description: Important: Student must correctly apply f = μN with normal force equal to weight mg for both objects.

title: Planetary mass-volume relation
description: Optional: Student uses ρ = M/(4πR³/3) to connect density to mass and radius.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly assigns direction of friction or tension, or misidentifies which object experiences larger net force.

title: Incorrect normal force
description: Pitfall: Student uses incorrect normal force (not mg) or misapplies the friction coefficient.
